children: Pons has burned 30% of the PONS total supply, permanently removing those tokens from circulation. The burn reduces the token's fixed supply rather than locking it, so the removed PONS cannot re-enter the market. The project announced the reduction as a tokenomics update, and the change applies to the total supply on record.

A permanent 30% supply reduction tightens PONS tokenomics directly: with fewer tokens in existence, each remaining unit represents a larger share of the network. Holders may reprice the token on this improved scarcity, and the effect depends on how the market weighs the smaller supply against existing demand. The burn figure is self-reported by the project, so verifying it through an on-chain burn address or supply tracker is a reasonable step before treating the reduction as confirmed.

title: Pons: 30% of Total PONS Supply Burned, Permanently Reducing Token Supply - 08 Sep 2026
